title: Vendor SOC reports and bridge letters obtained for the P09 review
source_system: Vendor portals; vendor email
what_it_shows: Payroll service SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 for the 12 months ending 2026-06-30 (RTO 4 hours, RPO 1 hour; 2 exceptions); portal vendor SOC 2 Type 2 for the 12 months ending 2026-06-30 (RTO 12 hours); MSSP SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) for the 12 months ending 2026-06-30, with high-severity escalation missing the 30-minute target in 2 of 40 samples; bridge letters to 2026-09-30 from the tax software, accounting, cloud, identity and productivity vendors; no bridge letter yet from the bill-pay service

title: CAS processing samples
source_system: Payroll service previews and change log; bank reconciliations; portal delivery logs
what_it_shows: Payroll previews (25 sampled payroll runs): second-person review documented for 15. The payroll change log shows changes received through the portal or by email, with no call-back record. Monthly bank reconciliations of client ledgers were completed for the sampled clients. Portal delivery logs show payroll reports and bill-pay confirmations delivered to clients, with client batch approvals

title: Privacy Officer review of public chatbot cases
source_system: Privacy Officer incident files; sanctions log
what_it_shows: The 9 public chatbot cases were reviewed as incidents: client names and notice amounts, no SSNs; all 9 staff were retrained, and 3 who had been warned before were sanctioned and recorded in the sanctions log

title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: IdP and HR exports; CAS payroll and bill-pay user lists; POL-02; samples of 25 of 131 seasonal accounts, 25 of 96 terminations, 25 of 58 transfers and 25 of 412 new accounts; IT Operations Manager and CAS Practice Leader interviews
what_it_shows: Seasonal accounts (25 of the 131 in EV-004): 14 disabled after the end date, an average of 3 business days late. Transfers (25 of 58): 9 kept DMS folder rights from the prior team. On 2026-08-14, 3 former CAS staff (terminated 2026-02 to 2026-05) still had active local accounts in the payroll and bill-pay services; they were disabled that day, and the vendors' logs showed no sign-in after the termination dates. CAS service account managers are not notified of terminations. Last access review 2026-01 (annual); seasonal accounts are not reviewed at season end. The shared scanning-station administrator password was not changed when 2 IT staff left in 2026. Account use in the tax software, DMS and CAS services is not monitored

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Admin role reports for the directory, identity provider, productivity suite and cloud; DMS permission export; test user from the individual tax team
what_it_shows: 14 IT staff hold standing directory or productivity suite administrator rights on daily accounts; a test user from one tax team opened client folders of every other tax team

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: Conditional access export; virtual desktop gateway policy; vendor remote tool inventory; sign-in test from an unmanaged device
what_it_shows: Usage restrictions and implementation guidance are documented; mailbox access from an unmanaged device succeeded with MFA only; two software vendors connect to DMS servers with their own remote tools without per-session authorization

title: Control assessment: information sharing under IRC 7216
source_system: Portal consent records; offshore queue routing log; samples of 25 offshore returns and 25 lender and adviser releases; Privacy Officer interview
what_it_shows: 4 of 25 offshore returns and 2 of 25 releases preceded the signed consent; no workflow check of the consent before routing or release; SSNs in scanned images are shown unmasked to offshore staff

title: Control assessment: literacy training
source_system: Training records (25 seasonal staff); phishing simulation reports; training content; 15 staff interviews
what_it_shows: 5 of 25 sampled seasonal staff had system access before completing security training and the privacy and IRC 7216 module; annual training and quarterly simulations run; content not updated after the 2026 token-theft and help desk impersonation attempts reported by the MSSP

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM source list; logging settings in the tax software, portal, DMS and CAS services; STD-02 draft
what_it_shows: Identity, email, EDR, firewall and cloud events are logged centrally; event types from the tax software, portal, DMS and CAS services are not identified or specified for logging; no documented rationale for the selected event types; event types not reviewed since 2024

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports; alert rule list and change history; after-hours test inbox rule and external forwarding attempt
what_it_shows: No review of tax software, portal, DMS or CAS activity; the test inbox rule raised no alert because the rule was suppressed; the MSSP suppressed inbox-rule alerts from 2026-02-02 to 2026-04-20; findings that are detected are reported

title: Control assessment: audit record retention
source_system: Retention settings; tax software vendor documentation
what_it_shows: SIEM data searchable for 1 year and cloud audit logs kept 7 years; tax software activity logs are kept 90 days by the vendor, while draft POL-03 and STD-02 set 1 year

title: Control assessment: penetration testing
source_system: 2025 penetration test report and scope letter; P01
what_it_shows: The 2025 test excluded the client portal configuration, the virtual desktop pool and the CAS platform tenant; the scope was not set from the risk assessment

title: Control assessment: configuration change control
source_system: Change tickets (25 of the 312 in 2026); tax software tenant audit log; Chief Information Officer and National Tax Practice Leader interviews
what_it_shows: Sampled infrastructure changes were documented, approved, implemented and reviewed through the change board; SaaS tenant settings are not defined as configuration-controlled or monitored; enabling the tax software AI drafting feature (2026-03) was not reviewed or approved with security, privacy or IRC 7216 consideration

title: Control assessment: component inventory
source_system: Device inventory; SaaS discovery report; cloud console export
what_it_shows: The device and cloud inventory reflects managed components and is reviewed; it omits SaaS services (SaaS discovery found 41 unapproved applications, 6 holding client data); records lack data classification and owner for SaaS and printers

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: 2025 DMS restore report; DR plan; CAS Practice Leader interview
what_it_shows: Only the DMS has been tested, and its results were reviewed with corrective actions; the workpaper application and the CAS repeat-payroll fallback have never been tested; no exercise for a deadline-week tax software vendor outage

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup reports (30 of 30 days, July 2026); vault lock settings; restore of one DMS folder in the assessors' presence
what_it_shows: 30 of 30 July backup days completed; backups are encrypted, write-once for 35 days, in a separate account and region; one DMS folder was restored from the backup account

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: IdP user export; CAS service user lists
what_it_shows: Every user, including offshore vendor staff and CAS local accounts, has a unique account

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: Sign-in tests on 25 of the 41 privileged accounts
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled privileged sign-ins required MFA with number matching

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Service desk procedure; service account inventory; authentication methods report; local administrator password comparison on 12 scanning stations; 3 test calls to the service desk
what_it_shows: The service desk reset MFA for a test caller who gave only an employee ID and manager name in 2 of 3 calls; no phishing-resistant authenticators for administrators or other high-risk users; CAS local accounts use SMS codes; 9 service accounts have non-expiring passwords; the 12 scanning stations share one local administrator password, not changed when IT staff left

title: Control assessment: client identification and authentication
source_system: Portal settings; enrollment report
what_it_shows: Clients are uniquely identified; MFA is optional and 58% of individual clients use it; portal enrollment verifies email only

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident queue (10 of 31 incidents); 2024 plan; draft P08 runbooks; 2025 tabletop report
what_it_shows: Detection, containment, eradication and recovery recorded for the sampled incidents and handled consistently; the 2024 plan had no playbook for refund holds, CAS payment holds or the IRS report, and 2 sampled BEC incidents had no refund-change check; 3 of 7 actions from the 2025 tabletop are not implemented

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: 15 staff interviews; POL-03; P08 notification matrix
what_it_shows: 4 of 15 staff interviewed did not know the reporting channel or the 1-hour rule; incident information reaches the incident response team

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: 2024 plan; draft POL-03 and P08 runbooks; distribution records
what_it_shows: The plan sets the roadmap, structure, reportable incidents, resources and responsibilities, and is protected; no metrics for the incident response capability; the plan has not been distributed to practice leaders, the CAS Practice Leader or the offshore vendor contact; plan changes are not communicated to the MSSP or the insurer panel contacts

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Destruction certificates (10 of 64); printer lease records
what_it_shows: Sampled certificates support paper and drive destruction; no sanitization certificate process for printer and scanner drives returned to the lessor (8 older devices store scans)

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Termination sample (25 of 96); CAS service user lists
what_it_shows: Identity provider access, exit steps and property return recorded for the sampled leavers; 3 former CAS staff kept local access in the payroll and bill-pay services after termination, and those credentials were not revoked

title: Control assessment: access agreements
source_system: Access agreement templates; acknowledgment report; contractor list
what_it_shows: Access agreements exist and are reviewed; MSSP analysts, scanner maintenance technicians and offshore vendor staff accessed systems without signing access agreements or receiving the written IRC 6713 and 7216 notice; 4% of staff had not re-signed the annual acknowledgment

title: Control assessment: external personnel security
source_system: Offshore vendor contract; Director of Tax Operations interview
what_it_shows: The contract sets personnel security terms; the offshore vendor is not required to report staff transfers or terminations within a set time; vendor compliance has not been monitored since onboarding

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 risk register and report; 2025 risk assessment; audit committee minutes
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment identifies threats and vulnerabilities, rates likelihood and impact, is documented, reviewed, updated annually and disseminated to the audit committee

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring and scanning
source_system: Scan reports Q3 2025 to Q2 2026; critical findings Q1-Q2 2026 (40 of 40); external scan of the VPN and virtual desktop gateways
what_it_shows: Scanning tools are automated and results are analyzed; the virtual desktop pool was not scanned after it went live in 2025-12; 6 of 40 critical findings were remediated after the 30-day target

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Contract sample (20 of 85); vendor files; offshore vendor contract; tax software AI sub-processor amendment
what_it_shows: 7 of 20 sampled provider contracts have no security or breach notice terms; privacy and IRC 7216 requirements are not flowed down to the offshore vendor or the AI sub-processor in a verifiable way; oversight roles are defined; reviews only at onboarding, with no ongoing monitoring

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall and route exports; reachability tests from the virtual desktop subnet and an office workstation subnet
what_it_shows: External interfaces are monitored and controlled; the virtual desktop subnet can reach all DMS shares; office workstation subnets are not filtered from each other; vendor remote tools connect outside the managed interfaces

title: Control assessment: transmission confidentiality
source_system: TLS scan; sample of 60 outbound emails with tax attachments
what_it_shows: TLS 1.2 or higher for the portal, e-file and SaaS; 31 of 60 sampled emails with tax return attachments were sent without encryption

title: Control assessment: protection of information at rest
source_system: Encryption reports; spot checks on 5 desktops and 4 printers
what_it_shows: Encryption confirmed on the sampled desktops; 8 older multifunction printers store scanned images on unencrypted drives

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch reports; critical findings Q1-Q2 2026
what_it_shows: Flaws are identified, reported, tested and corrected through monthly patching; 6 of 40 critical updates were installed after the 30-day target

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: MSSP reports; SIEM rule list; egress flow logs; after-hours tests of inbox rule creation and a bulk download of 500 test files from the DMS
what_it_shows: Unauthorized local, network and remote connections are monitored; monitoring objectives do not cover the tax software, portal, DMS or CAS services; the test bulk download of 500 DMS files raised no alert; no monitoring of egress volume from the DMS subnet; inbox-rule alerts were suppressed during filing season

title: Control assessment: information retention
source_system: Retention schedule; DMS age report
what_it_shows: Files of about 95,000 former-client consumers are retained past the schedule; exported copies (email attachments, local downloads) are not covered by the schedule

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments
source_system: Vendor files; STD-03 draft
what_it_shows: No supplier assessments or reviews since onboarding for Tier 1 providers, including the offshore vendor and the payroll service
